intro.title: Launch Your Business in the World's #1 Free Zone
intro.paragraph1: Dubai Multi Commodities Centre (DMCC) Free Zone is a globally acknowledged leader in business setup and trade facilitation — known for strategic location, ease of setup, and an exceptional legal framework.

intro.paragraph3: With over 21,000 businesses from 180 countries across crypto, commodities, tech, finance, and media — DMCC represents one of the most exciting and innovative business hubs in the world.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Everything you need to know about DMCC Free Zone. Still have questions? We're one message away.

items.q: What is DMCC Free Zone and why is it ideal for business setup in Dubai?
items.a: DMCC (Dubai Multi Commodities Centre) Free Zone is often considered the #1 free zone in the world, located in the hub of Dubai. DMCC has a vibrant community of businesses across commodities, crypto, consulting, trading, and professional services. It has simple registration, excellent legal frameworks, and great infrastructure — making DMCC the best free zone in Dubai for entrepreneurs and international businesses who want to grow quickly.

items.q: What types of licenses are available in DMCC Free Zone?
items.a: DMCC offers Trading License, Service License, Industrial License, E-commerce License, Freelance Permit, and Crypto/VARA License — tailored to different business models and industries.

items.q: How long does it take to register a company in DMCC Free Zone?
items.a: DMCC registration typically takes 5-7 business days for a standard application with complete documentation.

items.q: Can I get 100% foreign ownership for my DMCC company?
items.a: Yes. DMCC allows 100% foreign ownership with no local Emirati sponsor or UAE national partner required.

items.q: Which industries are best suited for DMCC Free Zone?
items.a: DMCC is ideal for commodities (gold, diamonds, tea, coffee), crypto & Web3, fintech, logistics, consulting, media, and professional services.

items.q: Can I open a bank account after getting a DMCC license?
items.a: Yes. DMCC has strong banking relationships that make corporate account approvals easier. We provide full assistance with KYC, documentation, and bank introductions.

items.q: Is DMCC Free Zone suitable for freelancers and small startups?
items.a: Absolutely. DMCC offers Freelance Permits for individuals and low-cost packages for startups — including flexi-desks with a single visa quota.

items.q: What are the office options available in DMCC Free Zone?
items.a: DMCC offers Flexi Desks, Executive Offices, Private Offices, and Virtual Offices — all located in the premium Jumeirah Lakes Towers (JLT) area.

items.q: What is the minimum cost to set up in DMCC?
items.a: DMCC company setup starts from AED 33,000 per year including membership, license, and flexi-desk.

items.q: Why choose Setup Zone Dubai for DMCC setup?
items.a: We offer transparent pricing, DMCC expertise, dedicated relationship managers, and end-to-end support — from license to visa to banking. All with 10,000+ successful setups.
